shot9.kind: HOT (solved WIDE) circe and the first scout, from her front

history.result: Kept. The pour is now on her (motion 0.45 -> 0.96) and the three strikes play from in front of her: her arm goes up and comes down on each man in turn, the struck ones jolt and the first goes down toward the pig; the shot moves on every drawing (10.68). Loose: there is no wand prop, the strike is her bare arm; the solver eased the planned mid to a wide (no legal mid saw her face), so the men are small; the swing amplitude (0.7) was held and is modest; shot 8 still frames her past a pig's pink back.
